text:
maria (arch): we're cutting over tenant residency for eu-anchored accounts tonight.
T.J.: reminder — cutover needs to respect consent windows. question: do we require quorum across active regions before promoting new primary?
sasha: we currently do 2/2 for the two-region setup. for active/active with 3 regions we'd want 2/3 to avoid split-brain.
lee: problem: some customers have residency constraints (EU-only). if we wait for cross-region quorum we might violate data residency during the brief window.
maria (arch): exactly. tradeoff: stronger safety vs residency. proposed: require local region lease + async escrow mirror to remote until consent is confirmed.
T.J.: sketch:
```
Client -> Region A (local) : write
Region A: grant local lease, ack to client
Region A -> escrow service: replicate metadata to Region B/C (async)
If escrow confirms consent within TTL -> promote global commit
else -> keep local-only and mark write as 'resident-pending'
```
lee: what about reads routed by residency header? header = X-Resident-Region: eu-west-1
sasha: yes header must be honored. fallback reads from non-resident regions are forbidden unless explicit cross-region consent flag set.
maria (arch): ops question: how do we detect a failed escrow that never returns? we need an operator visible metric/alert.
T.J.: ops-bot will emit escrow:pending > 5m and escrow:failed events. I can hook a runbook. @ops please confirm.
ops-bot: deployed escrow watcher; alerts configured to #eng-oncall for >5m.
lee: rollback behaviour? if region A loses connectivity mid-cutover, we should surface tenant to quarantine mode and route reads to standby with masking.
sasha: agree. Also set tenant flag "cutover_in_progress" to block cross-region writes until resolved.
maria (arch): final ask: can we document API header contract and TTLs? I'll open an RFC PR that includes the handshake and runbook snippets.
T.J.: +1. I'll add the alert thresholds and sample dashboards.
lee: +thumbsup: try to keep the resident-prefixed state machine small.
sasha: happy path looks good. edge cases will be followups.
maria (arch): thanks all. planning to cut at 03:00 UTC. I'll post a countdown in #release-war-room.
